purpose: Scientifically conservative journal benchmark; preserves the ECM problem while reducing unsupported proxy assumptions.

participation.proxy: mean historical exp(-haversine_distance_km / robust distance scale)
participation.rationale: frequency-aware historical availability; avoids equating one isolated nearby visit with repeated presence

quality.rationale: Gowalla/Brightkite contain no empirical sensing-quality labels

demand.interpretation: normalized system-load protocol, not observed task-demand labels

influence.interpretation: simulation protocol; friendship graph has no diffusion labels

objective.canonical: clip expected coverage after activation-probability averaging
objective.realized: clip coverage in each live-edge world then average

generalization_pilot.evaluation: load trained encoder/Q-network weights only; preserve target-instance embeddings and worker-pool buffers
